status: ON USER HOLD; pre-inference option-A amendment; not authorized to run

amendment.choice: A: relapse prevention, not clearing ongoing persistent false alarms
amendment.reason: A nonempty native prediction requires score>0, so the previous-score<=0 gate cannot directly interrupt a continuing native positive-score false alarm before trajectory divergence
amendment.question: Once the model declares absence, does suppressing stale foreground-interior memory prevent false-alarm relapse, and what are the re-detection and present-Dice costs?
amendment.not_claimed: No direct test of the42percent one-step persistent-FP clearance motivation; no threshold-calibrated or learned persistent-FP detector is introduced
amendment.feasibility: Count native GT-empty targets following empty predictions for SAM2 and SAMURAI before inference. These are mask-proxy baseline opportunities; exact score eligibility is unsaved and cannot be reconstructed from emptiness. Full feedback can change subsequent opportunities, so baseline counts are not a strict bound on every counterfactual effect.
amendment.risk: After a missed present frame, suppressing foreground memory may delay recovery; harm is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed monotonic effect in a nonlinear model

baseline_feasibility.verification: Archived PNG occupancy matches saved binary-metric occupancy on2012 targets per method. Exact object-score triggers are unavailable from legacy outputs.
baseline_feasibility.interpretation: Sparse direct relapse headroom; do not describe this as a direct persistent-FP-clearance test. No new data-tuned support cutoff is introduced.

analysis_role: Post hoc and exploratory on an already inspected PolypGen cohort; not a guarantee of a method paper

implementation.reuse: Existing cloned author repositories, pinned commits fetched again; unchanged author builders, native video predictor, object-score head, memory writing and SDPA; small project integration controller only
implementation.precision: FP32 projected Q/K/V, native stored memory precision
implementation.config: Same B+ checkpoint and native method configurations as final author benchmarks; no postprocessing

rule.signal: Previous processed frame's own stored object_score_logits; current-frame score is unavailable before its memory attention
rule.absent: score <= 0, exact complement of author's existing score > 0 presence rule; no new tuned threshold
rule.intervention: If previous score <= 0, mask only stored foreground-interior keys with additive negative infinity at all four memory cross-attention layers
rule.region: Primary native256 exact mixed-cell partition; foreground interior label1 only
rule.preserve: Background label0, boundary label2 and every pointer key; author frame selection and spatial positions unchanged
rule.restore: The first read after a positive processed-frame score uses native unmasked attention
rule.propagation: Intervention outputs are normally written by the unchanged author memory encoder and affect future predictions; not fixed-bank replay
rule.all_keys: Stop as undefined, never silently retain an arbitrary key
rule.limits: One-sampled-frame lag; self-confirming absence can delay recovery; no oracle GT used by the gate

cohort.initialization: Single first-labeled-foreground mask; seq1/seq7 unpromptable and N/A; no detector or corrections
cohort.samurai_indexing: Retain author runner's first-prompt rebase while retaining original source-frame indices
cohort.sampling: Irregularly sampled images; no interpolation and no seconds/original-frame latency claims
cohort.negative_only: Separate4275 image-only negative samples excluded; do not concatenate unrelated clips or invent prompts
cohort.absence_meaning: Provided all-zero mask, not missing mask; annotation-defined absence, not independently established clinical disappearance

metrics.primary_relapse_false_alarm_rate: Fixed risk set: GT-empty sampled targets whose previous score<=0 in the fresh unmodified native SAMURAI baseline. Evaluate all methods on these same source indices; zero-denominator sequences are N/A. Never redefine the paired risk set from the gated trajectory.
metrics.false_alarm_rate: Any nonempty prediction on GT-empty targets; report frame-pooled fraction and equal-sequence mean over eligible sequences with denominator
metrics.redetection: Return after a GT-empty run; first positive GT/prediction overlap, no Dice threshold; delay0 means same sampled return frame
metrics.censoring: If no overlap before next GT-empty run or sequence end, record undetected/censored event and available follow-up; never assign delay0 or discard silently
metrics.present_dice: Equal-sequence mean Dice on postprompt positive-GT targets
metrics.statistics: Sequence is the unit;10,000 sequence-bootstrap mean-difference intervals and paired two-sided Wilcoxon. Holm across2method contrasts times3endpoints: fixed-native-SAMURAI-risk relapse false-alarm rate,presentDice,returnfailurefraction. Overall GT-empty false-alarm rates and observed return delays are descriptive with censor counts, not survival-model estimates.
metrics.interpretation: This asks relapse prevention only. A lower relapse false-alarm rate alone is insufficient: report all-GT-empty FP, presentDice losses and re-detection failures/delays. If baseline opportunities are few, a null result is not evidence against region-aware methods generally. No outcome-driven minimum-support cutoff, threshold tuning or new noninferiority margin.

checks: observed token exclusion and native-score recovery
gate.full: Only after all four gates pass under identical source/checkpoint/manifest/precision/protection identities; then run three full conditions in fixed listed order
gate.stopping: Stop for integrity, mismatch, nonfinite, unavailable evidence or delivery failure. Unexpected scientific results are retained; no tuning or selective restart.
